title: The Taliban Kicked the U.S. Out of Afghanistan. Now They Want It Back.
summary: In an interview, Afghanistan’s foreign minister called on the U.S. to reopen its embassy and invest in the country — a near-impossible sell for now, analysts and former diplomats say.
